message:
Partial refunds now come out at the right amount, and `npm test` passes (20 of 20).

The bug was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`. `percent` is a 0–100 value, but the code multiplied the amount by it directly, so a 50% refund came out as 50 times the payment. It now divides by 100 before rounding. I changed nothing outside `src/payments`.
